title: Yellow Kissed Venezuelan Malai Empanadas
description: A sour and bouncy Venezuelan dish featuring malai, perfect for a cozy snack, this keto-friendly empanada is a delicious treat. The combination of malai and Venezuelan spices creates a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, coconut oil, and salt.
Add the chilled malai, lime juice, eggs, shredded cheese, and paprika to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of malai in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the malai and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops with coconut oil and bake for 20 minutes.
